additional_info.subject: Support Request – Repeated StatusNotification Messages in OCPP Traffic
additional_info.body:
One of our customers reported an issue related to OCPP message traffic.
According to the CPO’s logs attached, the charger sent 58 StatusNotification messages within one minute, which caused unexpected message traffic on their server.
The customer claims that such behavior is non-compliant with the OCPP standard.
We kindly request your support and clarification on this matter.

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0458683-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / PN 170001129] Repeated StatusNotification Messages in OCPP Traffic CRM:03056000365
additional_info.body:
Dear Emre-abi,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0458683
for charger
oIJ7A2
from Trugo.
The ticket was opened for a complain from end customer of out of standard behavior of the charger, which sent 58 StatusNotification messages within 1 minute.
I checked the Excel table reported in the ticket, but I cannot find the events reported for charger
oIJ7A2 - MP/PN 170001129.
The event of spamming of StatusNotification messages refers to 22.10.2025, and from the excel it seems it happened in proximity of #2 charging sessions, "transactionId": 23638 and "transactionId": 28699, but there is no record of those charging sessions for the mentioned charger. I believe the table, and therefore the event, refers to a different charger.
Could you please clarify on which charger did the issue happen, and the timestamp?
I also checked the OCPP 1.6 standard, and it does not mention any limitation on number of messages that can be sent per minute (including StatusNotification).
Could you please ask the customer to which part of the standard are they referring to, when they say that it is a non-compliant behavior?
Many thanks in advance for your feedback.
Looking forward to hearing form you soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei

Hi Fosco,
Thank you for your return. I will forward the following e-mail to the customer. I will inform you later
Upon reviewing the OCPP 1.6 standard, we found that there is no specified limit for the number of messages (including StatusNotification) that can be sent per minute.
We fully understand that your goal is to reduce server load; However, to evaluate whether this behavior is truly non-compliant, could you please specify which exact section or clause of the OCPP standard defines this limitation? This will help us ensure a technically accurate assessment of the situation.
